event.name: c. 1470 BC: Hatshepsut expedition to Punt, location and year uncertain

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The Deir el-Bahri reliefs depict an expedition to Punt in Hatshepsut’s regnal year 9; the linked article names envoy Nehsi and depicts Punt ruler Parahu and Ati. Absolute chronology is debated; -1470 is an approximate reference, not a verified departure, arrival, interaction or route. Coordinates mark the temple reliefs, not Punt, whose location is debated. Egyptian presentations of tribute are not independent proof of conquest. No spawnable people or political effect implied.
